gates.detail: The public build lists 178 camps from the eligible records. Nine theLIST points at Windermere Hut, Wild Dog Creek, New Pelion Hut and Waterfall Valley Hut are collapsed into one camp each. Lake St Clair Tourist Park and BIG4 Buttons Creek Summer Campground are commercial and are left out. Free camps, council showgrounds, and council or community parks stay.
The public build reads Parks and Wildlife Service alerts from the alerts page. Only the headline, the park names and the link are kept.

Free camps, council showgrounds, and council or community parks stay. Lake St Clair Tourist Park and BIG4 Buttons Creek Summer Campground are commercial and are left out. A commercial caravan, tourist or holiday park on the published list fails this check.
Pages link to the Tasmania Fire Service Total Fire Ban page and TasALERT. No fire rating is fetched.
Pages link to Tasmanian roadworks. The State Growth layer is not ingested.
No Tasmania segment is created. Signup stays off. Pages say the weekly email is coming soon.
The Victoria, New South Wales, Queensland and South Australia build and tests run with this activation.
